def guarded_pose(body, armor):
    targets = production(body, armor)
    delta = Matrix(targets['pelvis_pose_blender_cm']) @ Matrix(targets['pelvis_reference_blender_cm']).inverted()
    def smooth(value):
        value=max(0.,min(1.,value))
        return value*value*(3.-2.*value)
    for panel in targets['panels']:
        normal = Vector((math.sin(panel['theta']), -math.cos(panel['theta']), 0.))
        side = 'l' if panel['theta'] > 0 else 'r'
        direction = Vector(targets['thigh_directions_pelvis_blender'][side])
        sagittal=math.atan2(max(0.,-direction.y),max(.08,-direction.z))
        blend=0.
        azimuth=math.degrees(math.atan2(abs(direction.x),max(0.,-direction.y)))
        if panel['panel'] in ('Front_L','Front_R'):
            blend=smooth((math.degrees(sagittal)-50.)/25.)*(1.-smooth((azimuth-15.)/20.))
            normal=normal.lerp(Vector((direction.x,direction.y,0.)).normalized(),blend).normalized()
        sides = ('l', 'r') if panel['panel'] == 'Front_Center' else (side,)
        directions = [Vector(targets['thigh_directions_pelvis_blender'][side]) for side in sides]
        flex = max(math.atan2(max(0., direction.dot(normal)), max(.08, -direction.z)) for direction in directions)
        angle = max(0., min(math.pi / 2, flex - .02))
        if panel['panel'] in ('Side_L','Side_R'):
            angle=max(angle,side_floor*sagittal)
        pivot = Vector(panel['hinge_pivot_cm'])
        axis = Vector((normal.y, -normal.x, 0.))
        target = delta @ Matrix.Translation(pivot) @ Matrix.Rotation(angle, 4, axis) @ Matrix.Translation(-pivot) @ Matrix(panel['reference_blender_cm'])
        panel.update({'angle_radians': angle, 'target_blender_cm': mod.matrix_rows(target), 'probe_normal_blender': list(normal),'probe_cardinal_blend':blend,'probe_forward_azimuth_degrees':azimuth,'probe_side_floor_factor':side_floor})
    for panel in targets['panels']:
        armor.pose.bones[panel['bone']].matrix = Matrix(panel['target_blender_cm'])
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    return targets
